what_it_does: Google's AI research notebook that grounds answers and audio overviews in uploaded sources.
auth_notes: Google Cloud user credentials (gcloud auth / OAuth 2.0 access token sent as Bearer). Calls must come from an authenticated user account holding an active NotebookLM Enterprise licence plus the Cloud NotebookLM User IAM role (roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmUser).
access_notes: Only the NotebookLM Enterprise API (Gemini Enterprise, Google Cloud) exists; consumer NotebookLM has no public API. Requires setting up NotebookLM Enterprise in a GCP project and assigning paid licences. The docs page does not mention an allowlist. API is Preview (v1alpha, pre-GA, limited support). Whether a free trial licence is available was not confirmed.
api_notes: v1alpha REST under projects.locations.notebooks on discoveryengine.googleapis.com: notebooks create/get/listRecentlyViewed/batchDelete/share, plus separate source-management and audio-overview methods.
main_blocker: paid Enterprise licence required; Preview (v1alpha) API
human_needed: set up GCP project with NotebookLM Enterprise and assign a licence

what_it_does: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes conversations.
auth_notes: Official remote MCP server at https://mcp.otter.ai/mcp requires sign-in; Composio lists its auth as OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration. The separate Otter Public API uses an API key (Integrations > Developer) sent as a bearer token, per a third-party guide.
access_notes: MCP works with personal and enterprise Otter workspaces per the ChatGPT plugin page, but no official page found states which plans include it. A third-party guide (AnythingMCP) says the Otter Public API is offered only to Enterprise workspaces and may need the account manager to enable the Developer tab. Official Otter help pages could not be checked (search budget ran out).
api_notes: MCP exposes 3 tools: search, fetch (full transcript, summary, action items), get_user_info. Public REST API details are unconfirmed from official docs.
main_blocker: REST API reportedly Enterprise-only; MCP limited to 3 read tools
human_needed: Otter account to authorize OAuth; Enterprise workspace for REST API key

what_it_does: AI notetaker that records, transcribes and summarizes video meetings.
auth_notes: API key from User Settings > API Access, sent as X-Api-Key header. OAuth apps (developers.fathom.ai/oauth) for multi-user integrations; refresh tokens rotate and are single-use. OAuth apps cannot use include_transcript/include_summary on /meetings. Webhooks signed with HMAC-SHA256.
access_notes: Developer FAQ says API access, including keys and webhooks, is included on all plans. Rate limit 60 calls/min across all of a user's keys.
api_notes: External v1 REST API: list meetings (filters, cursor pagination), recording transcript/summary, teams, webhooks. Small surface focused on meeting data.

what_it_does: AI academic search engine that finds and synthesizes peer-reviewed research papers.
auth_notes: REST API: org-scoped API key sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>. The official MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 (Authorization Code + PKCE) with dynamic client registration; there is also an anonymous, heavily limited MCP tier. No OAuth flow was found for the REST API itself.
access_notes: API page says the REST API is included on every paid plan; keys come from consensus.app/subscription/api with quotas tied to the org subscription. A 'Create API key' button suggests self-serve after subscribing, so no request-only gate was found. The MCP server has a Free tier (1 QPS, 10 papers per search by default).
api_notes: GET /v1/search (ranked papers + full-text chunks), POST /v1/threads (async cited answer, modes incl. deep); also paper detail, synthesis, Consensus Meter.
main_blocker: paid plan required for REST API key
human_needed: buy a paid Consensus plan to get an API key (MCP OAuth works on free tier)

what_it_does: Document parsing API turning PDFs and files into LLM-ready structured data.
auth_notes: API key from Studio/docs (API Keys) sent as Authorization: Bearer $REDUCTO_API_KEY; SDKs read REDUCTO_API_KEY.
access_notes: Self-serve signup from the docs; free Standard plan includes $150 of usage, then pay-as-you-go. Growth/Enterprise are custom-priced.
api_notes: Endpoints: upload, parse (sync + async), extract (JSON schema), split, classify, edit (fill PDF forms / DOCX). Python, JS and Go SDKs.

what_it_does: Autonomous AI software engineer from Cognition that runs coding sessions.
auth_notes: v3 API uses service-user API keys or personal access tokens (cog_ prefix) as Authorization: Bearer. Service keys default to 30-day expiry. Legacy apk_/apk_user_ keys only work on v1/v2. MCP also needs X-Org-Id header for enterprise/PAT keys. OAuth not mentioned.
access_notes: API docs describe Teams/standard-org and Enterprise quickstarts; Enterprise API (/v3/enterprise) is enterprise-only. No free tier found; exact plan eligibility not stated in the docs.
api_notes: REST at api.devin.ai/v3/organizations/{org_id}/...: sessions, knowledge, playbooks, secrets, schedules, etc.; enterprise API adds analytics, audit logs, users, billing.
human_needed: subscribe to a paid Devin plan and create a service user key

what_it_does: Generative AI suite for image, video, audio and 3D content creation.
auth_notes: Developer API: key ID + secret from the Higgsfield console sent as 'Authorization: Key KEY_ID:KEY_SECRET' (legacy hf-api-key/hf-secret headers). CLI uses browser login ('higgsfield auth login') with an expiring local token, no API key; MCP is an account sign-in connection (exact auth method unconfirmed).
access_notes: The developer API is self-serve but pay-as-you-go from a prepaid USD balance (minimum $5 top-up), with no subscription and no free credits mentioned. The CLI and MCP need a paid Higgsfield subscription and use plan credits.
api_notes: Async REST generation API on api.higgsfield.ai across many models, with request status polling. CLI covers 35+ models plus Soul training, reframe/dubbing workflows and account commands.

what_it_does: Open-source CLI rendering Mermaid diagram definitions to SVG, PNG or PDF.
auth_notes: Local open-source tool (mmdc, npm @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli); no credentials needed.
access_notes: Free open-source package; runs locally via Node/Puppeteer or Docker. No hosted service.
api_notes: One function: render a .mmd/markdown input to an SVG/PNG/PDF image, with theme/config options. There is a Node API but no HTTP API, so a toolkit would need a sandbox that runs Node/headless Chromium.
main_blocker: no hosted API; needs local Node/Chromium execution

what_it_does: TranscriptAPI: REST API for YouTube transcripts, video, channel and playlist data.
auth_notes: API key (sk_...) from dashboard sent as Authorization: Bearer. The MCP server also supports OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration.
access_notes: Free one-time plan with 100 credits (60 req/min) per the TranscriptAPI MCP README; paid Starter plans raise limits to 200-300 req/min. Free endpoints still need an account with at least 1 active credit.
api_notes: 13 GET endpoints under https://transcriptapi.com/api/v2/youtube/: transcript, info, video metadata, search, channel resolve/info/search/videos/playlists/posts/sections/latest, playlist videos.

what_it_does: AI meeting recorder producing notes, clips and sales-call insights.
auth_notes: Personal Access Token (Account settings > Integrations > Personal API) or Workspace Access Token (admins, Business/Enterprise) sent as Bearer. OAuth2 is required for integrations distributed to other users. Requests need a Public-Api-Version header. MCP uses OAuth or a PAT.
access_notes: PATs are available on all plans, including Free. Workspace tokens need Business/Enterprise. OAuth app plan requirement and whether registration is self-serve are not stated. Rate limit 300 req/min per token.
api_notes: Public API v2 (api.grain.com/_/public-api/v2): recordings, highlights/clips, uploads, hooks (webhooks), token info and more.
